title: Pachuco
bio:
BARRIO TRAX WORLDWIDE with Pachuco (Monthly)

Pachuco is a Xicano DJ, collector, and music archivist raised between East Los Angeles and Whittier, California. His work is dedicated to preserving electronic dance music created by Latinx and Indigenous producers, with a focus on sounds that emerged from barrios, working-class neighborhoods, and underground communities throughout the 1990s and 2000s.

Built from years of collecting and archiving vinyl and CDs, his selections explore the connections between local scenes and global underground movements from records produced by Angelenos and the sounds that defined Los Angeles’ rave era, to electronic music cultures that developed in working-class communities around the world.

Centered around 1990s U.S. hard house, his archive expands through Latin electronic music, electro, ghetto house, ghetto techno, freestyle, and other underground styles. Through his mixes, Pachuco highlights the cultural histories behind these records, celebrating the communities that created them and preserving the sounds that shaped generations of dance floors.
